name: Maria di Marino
bioAdditions: A FamilySearch tree profile for Maria Di Marino (9CF8-2TL) names her parents as Gaetano Di Marino and Caterina di Leo. It gives her birth as c.1835 and her death as 29 Dec 1914 in Guardia Lombardi, citing a 1914 Guardia death act on Antenati (an_ua524129/La8qX6B, not opened here because Antenati is blocked) and an Avellino record index (S1). The profile names her husband 'Nicola di Paola', whereas Round 3 read the 1857 marriage index as 'Nicola di Pietro'. It also attaches, oddly, a New York City marriage index. Her death act would settle the husband's surname.
